content.content:
Here are my recommendations for your trip to Paris on November 15th:

**Restaurant Recommendation:**
- **Name:** Le Baratin
- **Cuisine:** Authentic French
- **Rating:** 4.8/5 (highest rated among French restaurants)
- **Address:** 3 Rue Jouye-Rouve, 75020 Paris, France
- **Price per person:** €30
- **Why:** This cozy bistro is celebrated for its delicious, homestyle cooking with a daily changing menu based on fresh market ingredients. It has the highest rating (4.8) among all French restaurants in Paris and offers an authentic dining experience. At €30 per person, two meals (lunch and dinner) would cost €60 total.

**Hotel Recommendation:**
- **Name:** Montmartre Suites
- **Rating:** 4.7/5
- **Address:** 23 Rue Lepic, 75018 Paris, France
- **Price range:** €110-200 per night (minimum price: €110)
- **Why:** This highly-rated hotel offers luxurious suites with stunning views of Montmartre. With a minimum price of €110, it fits well within your €500 budget when combined with your meals (€110 + €60 = €170 total, leaving you €330 for other expenses).

**Budget Summary:**
- Hotel (minimum): €110
- Two meals at Le Baratin: €60
- **Total:** €170 (well within your €500 budget)

Both recommendations are highly rated and will provide you with an authentic Parisian experience!
